title: The Lives of Harry Lime
paragraphs: Prequel/spinoff adventure series centered on Harry Lime before his death in The Third Man.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: 52-program syndicated run (August 3, 1951 to July 25, 1952).

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Anton Karas (performer and zither), Harry Alan Towers (producer and performer), [[person|orson-welles|Orson Welles]] (performer and writer), Tig Roe (director), Betty McDowell (performer), Graham Greene (creator), and Robert Rieti (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.244a08401c2c9142|WRVR-FM]].

The stories often return to confidence schemes and swindles, international travel and cosmopolitan settings, art, jewels and valuable objects, romance and seduction, murder and homicide, and blackmail and coercion.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes The Third Man character becomes a radio prequel lead, Transcribed international syndication, Harry Lime softened for weekly radio, and Harry Lime material feeds Mr. Arkadin.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|theatre-royal|Theatre Royal]], [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]], [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|the-fred-allen-show|The Fred Allen Show]], and [[show|the-mercury-theatre-on-the-air|The Mercury Theatre on the Air]].

The run breaks into several distinct periods: 52-program syndicated run (August 3, 1951 to July 25, 1952).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to WRVR-FM.

The stories often return to confidence schemes and swindles, international travel and cosmopolitan settings, art, jewels and valuable objects, romance and seduction, murder and homicide, and blackmail and coercion.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes The Third Man character becomes a radio prequel lead, Transcribed international syndication, Harry Lime softened for weekly radio, and Harry Lime material feeds Mr. Arkadin.
